summary: Pyxis Tankers Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching two press releases: one announcing the date (May 18, 2026) for the release of first quarter 2026 results, and the other presenting the actual unaudited financial results for the three months ended March 31, 2026. Revenues were $10M, net income $2.4M ($0.23 per share). These are routine earnings disclosures by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No M&A, restructuring, or other corporate event is involved. The filing is a standard regulatory requirement for ongoing reporting. No deal terms or structural changes are present.
